Ideal Gift: The classical color of black butter dish for countertop can go well with all kinds of tableware and could be the stylish addition of your kitchen. In addition, its stainless steel knife is convenient for eating. They are an attractive Xmas gift for your family and friends on Christmas Day.

Large Butter Dish: The capacity of our butter dish is 650 ml, and they measures 6.2 x 3.9 x 2.9 inches. The butter container is suitable for most butter brands such as Kerrygold, Perfecting for butter lovers.They no longer have to choose a brand of butter based on the size of the butter dish.
